label: 1 Peter is addressed to Christians in the province of Asia

place.note: Pleiades has no clean settlement-style resource for the province of Asia. The two 'Asia' province records (991380, 1001906) are Barrington Atlas map labels filed under Pleiades /errata; the only /places record (915832) is unlocated. 991380 is used here because it carries a representative point (37.5, 27.5) and resolves in the index. The province is otherwise densely attested at city level in batches 1–3 (Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, Laodicea, Colossae, Hierapolis, Troas).

date.note: Composition of 1 Peter. Traditional Petrine authorship puts it before Peter's death under Nero (c. 64); the majority view holds it pseudonymous, c. 70–90. Harnack (p. 186 n.) assigns it to 'the earlier years of Domitian' (c. 81–85). Upper bound 96 (end of Domitian); a minority dates it into the early second century.

secondary.cite: Harnack, Mission and Expansion, vol. 2, p. 186

notes: Recorded so that 1 Peter's witness to the province of Asia is not lost behind the city-level items, which come from other sources (the Apocalypse, Acts, the Pauline letters). Harnack notes 1 Peter's opening among the evidence for Christians in Asia (p. 186).
